data.exact_reserve_text: The 2021 net technical result of GBP 96.9m (2020: GBP (26.2)m) includes GBP 68.4m (2020: GBP 45.0m) of releases from reserves in respect of prior accident years.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported gross claims outstanding at the prior-year comparative (opening) of GBP 870.49m and recorded gross prior-year releases of GBP 68.392m in 2021 (a release of c.7.9% of opening gross claims). The releases were reported as coming from prior accident years and were reflected across principal classes (notably Marine, Property and Energy), leading to a favourable impact on the net technical result.
raw_causal_phrases: includes GBP 68.4m (2020: GBP 45.0m) of releases from reserves in respect of prior accident years

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and Other Damage to Property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from the Balance Sheet liabilities (Claims outstanding) prior-year comparative column (page 20). Prior year movement taken from the Technical Provisions note (Claims outstanding) which shows a gross 'Total prior year releases' of GBP 68,392k (page 43) and the explanatory sentence stating GBP 68.4m releases. Gross premium mix percentages taken from the segmental breakdown (page 4) and applied to the reported total gross written premium (896,699k) to compute amounts. LOB mapping: 'Reinsurance' in the prior-year breakdown was mapped to 'Reinsurance - Specialty' for standardized LOBs. A gross claims development triangle is present in the notes (pages 44-45) but was not fully transcribed here; triangle exists in GBP 000. All monetary amounts in this JSON are in millions. Confidence levels reflect explicit reported figures (1.0) and calculated allocations (0.8).
